im-c60-01.h: 이동 중 편승 행동 (-는 길에) vs 진행 중단 (-다가)

a.d: Taking advantage of moving toward a destination (출근길, 퇴근길, 등굣길) to handle a quick errand or encounter.
ex: 퇴근하**는 길에** 마트에 들러 우유를 샀어요. — On my way home from work, I dropped by the mart and bought milk.

b.d: Focuses on an ongoing action being stopped or interrupted by an unexpected event.
ex: 밥을 먹**다가** 전화를 받았어요. — While eating, I answered the phone.

im-c60-01.tip: -는 길에 attaches specifically to transit verbs of movement: 가다, 오다, 출근하다, 퇴근하다, 들르다, 나가다.

im-c60-01.q: Fix the sentence where a non-movement stationary action was mistakenly paired with -는 길에.
im-c60-01.wrong: 도서관에서 책을 읽는 길에 잠이 들었어요.
answers: 도서관에서 책을 읽다가 잠이 들었어요.
도서관에서 책을 읽다가 잠이 들었어요
도서관에서 책을 읽다가 깜빡 잠이 들었습니다.
도서관에서 책을 읽다가 깜빡 잠이 들었습니다
im-c60-01.hint: Use the interruption connector -다가 for reading books: 읽다가.
im-c60-01.why: Reading is a stationary activity, not a transit movement, so -다가 must be used.

items.ex: 집에 가는 길에 약국에 잠시 들렀다.

im-c60-01.say: 퇴근하는 길에 집 앞 제과점에 들러 갓 구운 식빵을 샀어요
answers: 퇴근하는 길에 집 앞 제과점에 들러 갓 구운 식빵을 샀어요
퇴근하는 길에 집 앞 제과점에 들러 갓 구운 식빵을 샀어요.
im-c60-01.hint: On my way home from work, I stopped by the bakery in front of my house and bought freshly baked bread.
im-c60-01.why: Transit route errand pattern: 퇴근하는 길에.

im-c60-01.q: Write a sentence stating that you bought freshly baked bread on your commute home, using 퇴근하는 길에 and 빵을 샀어요.
im-c60-01.sample: 회사에서 퇴근하는 길에 골목 빵집에서 따뜻한 빵을 샀어요.
im-c60-01.why: Using -는 길에 to describe purchasing snacks during a commute.

base.en: On the way home from work, I met a friend.

steps.en: On the way home from work at the subway station, I bumped into a high school alumnus friend by chance.

tokens: 회사 일을 마치고 지하철역에서 퇴근하는 길에
십 년 만에 우연히 반가운 고등학교
steps.en: On the way home from the subway station after finishing company work, I happily met a fond high school classmate friend on the street by chance after ten years.

ko: 퇴근하는 길에 지하철역 앞을 지나는데 고소한 냄새가 코를 찔렀다.
추운 바람을 맞으며 걷는 길에 노점에서 갓 구운 따끈한 붕어빵을 한 봉지 샀다.
품 안에 따뜻한 간식을 품고 집으로 향하는 길에 발걸음이 한결 가벼워졌다.
en: On my way home from work passing by the front of the subway station, a savory aroma struck my nose.
Walking while facing the chilly wind, on my way I bought a bag of piping hot, freshly baked bungeoppang from a street stall.
Carrying warm treats in my embrace on the way heading home, my footsteps became much lighter.

im-c60-01.q: What delicious snack did the author buy on the commute home?
options: Piping hot bungeoppang from a street stall
An icy smoothie from a cafe
A pack of salted peanuts from the train
im-c60-01.why: The author bought a bag of freshly baked bungeoppang: 노점에서 갓 구운 따끈한 붕어빵을 한 봉지 샀다.

im-c60-01.q: What does the grammar pattern -는 길에 signify in this story?
options: Performing an incidental errand while moving along a travel route
A permanent residency relocation
A completed task from childhood
im-c60-01.why: -는 길에 indicates taking advantage of an ongoing commute route.

items: I can talk about side errands, meetings, and purchases made en route using -는 길에.
I can ask friends for casual favors along their route (오는 길에 우유 사다 줄래?).

im-c60-02.h: 이유 목적 (-느라고) vs 행동 도중 중단·전환 (-다가)

a.d: Focuses on the energy or time consumed by action A that caused delay or inability to do action B.
ex: 시험공부를 **하느라고** 어제 잠을 전혀 못 잤어요. — Because of studying for the exam, I couldn’t sleep at all yesterday.

b.d: Focuses on the sudden interruption of action A midway, transitioning into action or accident B.
ex: 시험공부를 **하다가** 책상 위에서 깜빡 잠이 들었어요. — While studying for the exam, I dozed off on the desk.

im-c60-02.tip: -다가 keeps the consonant stem as is without adding extra vowels: 듣다 becomes 듣다가 (not 들다가).

im-c60-02.q: Fix the irregular conjugation error with -다가 for the verb 듣다.
im-c60-02.wrong: 감미로운 음악을 들다가 너무 감동해서 눈물이 났어요.
answers: 감미로운 음악을 듣다가 너무 감동해서 눈물이 났어요.
감미로운 음악을 듣다가 너무 감동해서 눈물이 났어요
감미로운 음악을 듣다가 너무 감동해서 눈물이 났습니다.
감미로운 음악을 듣다가 너무 감동해서 눈물이 났습니다
im-c60-02.hint: -다가 attaches directly to the consonant stem: 듣다가.
im-c60-02.why: The suffix -다가 begins with consonant ㄷ, so ㄷ-irregular verb stems retain ㄷ: 듣다가.

items.en: blinking / momentarily forgetting or nodding off

im-c60-02.say: 도서관에서 밤늦게까지 시험공부를 하다가 깜빡 잠이 들어 버렸어요
answers: 도서관에서 밤늦게까지 시험공부를 하다가 깜빡 잠이 들어 버렸어요
도서관에서 밤늦게까지 시험공부를 하다가 깜빡 잠이 들어 버렸어요.
im-c60-02.hint: While studying late into the night at the library, I blinked and fell fast asleep.
im-c60-02.why: Action interruption mid-stride with -다가: 시험공부를 하다가.

im-c60-02.q: Write a sentence describing that you almost tripped and fell while running, using 뛰어가다가 and 넘어질 뻔했어요.
im-c60-02.sample: 급하게 길을 뛰어가다가 돌부리에 걸려 넘어질 뻔했어요.
im-c60-02.why: Using -다가 to describe an accident occurring in the middle of running.

steps.en: While studying for the exam at the library, I was tired and blinked into a deep sleep.

tokens: 조용한 도서관 열람실에서 밤늦게 시험공부를 하다가
밀려오는 피곤함 때문에 책상 위에서 깜빡
한 시간 동안 깊은 잠이 들었어요.
steps.en: While studying late at night for exams in the quiet library reading room, due to flooding fatigue I blinked onto the desk and fell into a deep sleep for an hour.

ko: 주말에 방 청소를 하다가 책장 구석에서 낡은 사진첩을 발견했다.
사진을 한 장씩 넘겨보다가 학창 시절 친구들과 함께 웃던 추억이 떠올랐다.
추억에 젖어 이야기를 나누다가 시간 가는 줄도 모르고 해가 저물었다.
en: While cleaning the room over the weekend, I discovered an old photo album in a corner of the bookshelf.
While flipping through photos one by one, memories of laughing with school friends came to mind.
Immersed in reminiscing and talking, the sun set without even noticing time passing.

im-c60-02.q: What unexpected item did the speaker discover while doing chores?
options: An old photo album tucked in a corner of the bookshelf
An envelope filled with money under the floor
A lost airline ticket to Japan
im-c60-02.why: Line one states: 방 청소를 하다가 책장 구석에서 낡은 사진첩을 발견했다.

im-c60-02.q: What narrative thread connects the events in the passage?
options: One activity being interrupted by a new realization or transition mid-action
A schedule planned meticulously with a timer
A business conflict between coworkers
im-c60-02.why: -다가 moves the story naturally from cleaning to discovering, viewing, reminiscing, and sunset.

items: I can recount sudden shifts and unexpected happenings mid-activity with -다가.
I can describe daily mishaps like tripping, nodding off, or phone calls interrupting chores.

im-c60-03.h: 하던 중 (-다가, 미완료) vs 다 하고 나서 (-았/었다가, 완료 후 반대)

a.d: Action A was incomplete or cut short right in the middle.
ex: 옷을 입**다가** 단추가 툭 떨어졌어요. — While in the middle of putting on clothes, a button dropped off.

b.d: Action A was fully completed first, then reversed, undone, or followed by an opposite reaction.
ex: 옷을 **샀다가** 사이즈가 안 맞아서 환불했어요. — I bought the clothes, but returned them because the size didn’t fit.

im-c60-03.tip: Classic reversible pairs: 열었다가 닫다, 켰다가 끄다, 탔다가 내리다, 갔다가 돌아오다, 샀다가 환불하다.

im-c60-03.q: Fix the sentence where an action that was completely finished before reversal was mistakenly written with -다가.
im-c60-03.wrong: 신발을 완전히 신다가 사이즈가 작아서 다시 벗었어요.
answers: 신발을 신었다가 사이즈가 작아서 다시 벗었어요.
신발을 신었다가 사이즈가 작아서 다시 벗었어요
신발을 신어 보았다가 사이즈가 작아서 다시 벗었습니다.
신발을 신어 보았다가 사이즈가 작아서 다시 벗었습니다
im-c60-03.why: The shoes were completely put on first before being taken off, requiring -았/었다가.

items.ex: 마음에 들지 않아 영수증을 내고 환불했다.
지갑을 책상 위에 두었다가 깜빡 잊고 나왔다.
스티커를 벽에 붙였다가 자국 없이 뗐습니다.

im-c60-03.say: 방 안이 더워서 에어컨을 켰다가 찬바람이 불어와서 다시 껐어요
answers: 방 안이 더워서 에어컨을 켰다가 찬바람이 불어와서 다시 껐어요
방 안이 더워서 에어컨을 켰다가 찬바람이 불어와서 다시 껐어요.
im-c60-03.hint: Because the room was hot, I turned on the air conditioner, then turned it off again because cold air blew.
im-c60-03.why: Completed action followed by opposite reversal: 켰다가.

im-c60-03.q: Write a sentence stating that you went to the department store but came right back because there were no clothes you liked, using 갔다가 and 돌아왔어요.
im-c60-03.sample: 백화점에 쇼핑하러 갔다가 마음에 드는 옷이 없어서 그냥 돌아왔어요.
im-c60-03.why: Using 갔다가 돌아왔어요 to describe visiting a destination and returning.

base.en: I opened the window, then closed it again.

steps.en: I opened the window to ventilate, but cold wind blew so I closed it again.

tokens: 답답한 공기를 환기하려고 거실 창문을 활짝 열었다가
steps.en: I swung open the living room window to ventilate stuffy air, but sudden harsh cold wind and fine dust blew in, so I hurriedly closed it again.

ko: 지난 주말 인터넷 쇼핑몰에서 마음에 드는 셔츠를 주문했다가 색상이 화면과 달라 반품했다.
퇴근길에 근처 매장에 직접 들렀다가 마침 원하는 사이즈의 재고를 발견했다.
옷을 거울 앞에서 입어 보았다가 핏이 딱 맞아 기분 좋게 구매했다.
en: Last weekend I ordered a shirt I liked from an online shopping mall, but returned it because the color differed from the screen.
I stopped by a nearby physical store on my commute home, and happened to discover stock in my desired size.
After trying the clothes on before the mirror, the fit was perfect and I purchased it pleasantly.

im-c60-03.q: Why did the author return the shirt ordered online?
options: Because the physical color differed from what appeared on screen
Because the delivery arrived three months late
Because the buttons were completely missing
im-c60-03.why: Sentence one states: 주문했다가 색상이 화면과 달라 반품했다.

options: -았/었다가 signals that the initial action was fully concluded before reversing or altering direction
-았/었다가 means an action is indefinitely postponed forever
-았/었다가 only applies to eating food
im-c60-03.why: -았/었다가 marks completion of the initial deed before initiating a counter-action.

items: I can clearly distinguish mid-action disruptions (-다가) from completed-then-reversed actions (-았/었다가).
I can recount consumer decisions, shopping refunds, visits, and course corrections naturally.

im-c60-04.h: 단편적 사건 나열 vs 전환 표현을 엮은 생생한 일상 담화

a.d: Reports actions disconnectedly without conveying dynamic twists and turns.
ex: 퇴근했어요. 마트에 갔어요. 요리했어요. 손을 다쳤어요. — I came home. Went to mart. Cooked. Hurt hand.

b.d: Connects transit, pauses, and sudden turnarounds for a captivating real-world story.
ex: 퇴근하**는 길에** 장을 봐서 찌개를 끓이**다가** 손을 살짝 베여서 밴드를 붙였어요. — On my way home I bought groceries, and while boiling stew I slightly nicked a finger, so I applied a band-aid.

im-c60-04.tip: Skillful everyday Korean conversation brings daily anecdotes to life by chaining -는 길에, -다가, and -았/었다가.

im-c60-04.q: Fix the sentence where an ongoing phone call being cut off by battery drain was awkwardly phrased.

answers: 전화를 받다가 배터리가 다 닳아서 통화가 뚝 끊겼어요.
전화를 받다가 배터리가 다 닳아서 통화가 뚝 끊겼어요
전화를 하다가 배터리가 다 닳아서 통화가 뚝 끊겼습니다.
전화를 하다가 배터리가 다 닳아서 통화가 뚝 끊겼습니다
im-c60-04.hint: Use the mid-action interruption connector -다가: 받다가 / 하다가.
im-c60-04.why: The phone conversation was ongoing when interrupted by dead battery, requiring -다가.

items.ex: 허리를 삐끗해서 한의원에 침을 맞으러 갔다.
휴대폰 배터리가 다 닳아서 충전기를 꽂았다.

im-c60-04.say: 친구와 전화 통화를 나누다가 배터리가 다 닳아서 통화가 뚝 끊겼어요
answers: 친구와 전화 통화를 나누다가 배터리가 다 닳아서 통화가 뚝 끊겼어요
친구와 전화 통화를 나누다가 배터리가 다 닳아서 통화가 뚝 끊겼어요.
im-c60-04.hint: While sharing a phone call with a friend, the battery ran out and the call abruptly disconnected.
im-c60-04.why: Ongoing conversation cut short with -다가: 통화를 나누다가.

im-c60-04.q: Write a sentence describing that you slightly cut your finger while cooking and applied a band-aid, using 요리를 하다가 and 베여서.
im-c60-04.sample: 저녁 요리를 하다가 손가락을 살짝 베여서 구급함에서 밴드를 찾아 붙였어요.
im-c60-04.why: Using -다가 to narrate a minor mishap occurring during cooking.

base.en: My friend bought coffee on their way.

steps.en: On the way to the meeting place, my friend bought warm coffee at a famous cafe.

tokens: 눈길을 뚫고 약속 장소로 친구가 서둘러 오는 길에
내가 좋아하는 따뜻한 바닐라 라테를 사 왔어요.
steps.en: On the way rushing to the meetup place through the snow, my friend bought the hot vanilla latte I love from a famous roastery cafe in the alley.

ko: 어제 퇴근하는 길에 집 근처 마트에 들렀다가 싱싱한 채소를 저렴하게 샀다.
집에 돌아와 된장찌개를 끓이다가 소금을 너무 많이 넣어 국물이 짜졌다.
물을 더 붓고 찌개를 끓였다가 마침내 간이 딱 맞아 맛있는 저녁 식사를 마쳤다.
en: Yesterday on my way home from work I stopped by a mart near home and bought fresh vegetables cheaply.
Coming home and cooking soybean paste stew, I added too much salt mid-cooking and the soup became salty.
After pouring more water and boiling the stew, the seasoning finally became just right and I finished a delicious dinner.

im-c60-04.q: What mishap happened while the speaker was boiling the stew?
options: Added too much salt midway, making the soup salty
The pot burned down completely and caught fire
Spilled all the stew onto the kitchen floor
im-c60-04.why: Line two says: 된장찌개를 끓이다가 소금을 너무 많이 넣어 국물이 짜졌다.

im-c60-04.q: Which transition endings appear across the story’s journey from mart to dinner table?
options: -는 길에 (commute stop), -다가 (cooking mistake), and -았/었다가 (boiling adjustments)
-자마자, -거늘, and -ㄹ세라
-더니, -느라고, and -을망정
im-c60-04.why: The narrative seamlessly links -는 길에, -다가, and -았/었다가.

items: I can string together daily adventures, transit stops, and domestic mishaps fluidly.
I can explain unexpected turns in daily routines and how subsequent actions resolved them.
